convert_blip_diffusion_to_diffusers: run the script to convert a LAVIS BLIP Diffusion model to a Diffusers BlipDiffusionPipeline checkpoint
extract_qformer_from_checkpoint: extract the QFormer model weights from a LAVIS BLIP Diffusion checkpoint and load them into a Blip2QFormerModel
map_visual_encoder_weights: map visual encoder layer weights from a LAVIS checkpoint to the Diffusers visual encoder format
map_qformer_encoder_weights: map QFormer encoder layer weights including attention and cross-attention from a LAVIS checkpoint to Diffusers format
save_blip_diffusion_pipeline: assemble a BlipDiffusionPipeline with a converted QFormer, Stable Diffusion VAE, UNet, and text encoder then save it
